title: Electrospray Ionization Mass Spectrometry Insights into the Assembly of Lanthanide-Containing Clusters
claim: Fragmentation and incomplete detection can obscure the solution-phase assembly picture obtained from ESI-MS alone.
explanation: The authors propose gentler cold-spray ionization and complementary tandem, ion-mobility, and energy-resolved measurements to investigate metastable species, connectivity, shape, and stability.
scope: Mass-spectrometric studies of fragile lanthanide-containing clusters and their intermediates.
caveats: These additional methods are presented primarily as prospects for addressing limitations, not as a demonstrated complete solution for the reviewed systems.
